subject: Request: CIO handover & compressed demo window for Riverbank pilot
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Simon Park <simon.park@riverbank.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CIO handover & compressed demo window for Riverbank pilot

Hi Simon —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We’re excited to move Riverbank into the pilot phase and want to host a short executive intro + focused demo next week so your CIO and VP can see the flow end-to-end. We understand schedules are tight, so we’re prepared to compress the session to 25–30 minutes and focus on the three things that matter most to you: latency SLA examples, data isolation for the pilot, and an ops/runbook preview.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 20 Oct, 10:00–10:30
- Tue 20 Oct, 16:00–16:30
- Wed 21 Oct, 09:00–09:30

Can you confirm which of those works for your CIO and whether the VP will join? If those times don’t work we can offer a noon slot. I’ve attached a short prep doc and a compressed agenda for the 25-minute format.

If the CIO’s availability is extremely tight, we can run a 20-minute exec handover (3 slides + live demo) and follow with a separate technical deep-dive with your engineering team.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
David.Kim@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachment: Riverbank_Pilot_Preparation.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)
From: Simon Park <simon.park@riverbank.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Ortiz <clara.ortiz@riverbank.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 12:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: CIO handover & compressed demo window for Riverbank pilot

David —

Appreciate the concise options. Our CIO has a very constrained calendar next week due to board prep; the only realistic windows are:
- Tue 20 Oct, 16:00–16:20 PT (shorter than you proposed)
- Wed 21 Oct, 09:15–09:45 PT (but CIO may need to drop at 09:30)

The VP is likely to join for at least part of the session but I can’t guarantee full attendance. Can you confirm a 20-minute agenda (must include an SSO/data flow slide and one customer latency example), and who from Redwood will be speaking on product strategy vs. technical ops?

Also worth noting — procurement has a standing meeting Tue 20 at 15:30 PT and may request a short follow-up.

Simon
Simon Park
Chief of Staff, Riverbank AI
simon.park@riverbank.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CIO handover & compressed demo window for Riverbank pilot

Quick internal note —

If Riverbank needs a 20-minute slot, Marcus should lead the session: he can do a 7-minute exec-focused opener (latency, SLOs, deployment options) and then a 10-minute live demo focusing on the pilot path. I’ll volunteer to join the Q&A and cover procurement-facing asks (licensing/contract cadence). We should prepare:
- 1-slide SSO & data flow
- 1-slide latency/regression example from a similar pilot (anonymized)
- 1-slide handoff/runbook cadence

Marcus: can you draft a 20-minute run order and call out which engineer will be on the follow-up deep-dive?

Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Simon Park <simon.park@riverbank.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: CIO handover & compressed demo window for Riverbank pilot

Simon —

Thanks for the windows. We can do the compressed format and Marcus will lead the session. Proposed confirmed slot:
- Tue 20 Oct, 16:00–16:20 PT (we’ll keep strict time)

20-minute run order (attached):
1) 0:00–0:07 — Marcus Lin (exec opener: latency/SLOs & deployment options)
2) 0:07–0:17 — Live demo (pilot flow, KV cache, isolation)
3) 0:17–0:20 — Q&A / next steps (Laura to cover procurement/contract cadence)

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Calendar invite will follow from my side; please include your CIO + VP if they plan to drop in. We’ll keep slides to two bullets per slide and have an engineer on standby for the deep-dive (Alexei Morales from infra).

Attached: compressed-demo-agenda.docx — includes the 1-slide SSO/data flow and the anonymized latency example.

If the CIO absolutely needs to shorten further, Marcus can reduce the demo to a 6-minute highlight and we’ll schedule a separate technical deep-dive within 48 hours.

Thanks — look forward to it.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
David.Kim@redwood.com
